mapper.select: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.ticket_no, t.ticket_title, t.ticket_type, t.dept_id, t.owner_user_id, t.status, t.remark, t.create_time FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_ticket (ticket_no, ticket_title, ticket_type, dept_id, owner_user_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{ticketTitle}, #{ticketType}, #{deptId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, #{remark})
